name: 07_tts_failure_mid_call
description: Resilience (scripted): turn 1 normal; turn 2 the in-house TTS stream drops after 2 chunks (mid-sentence) and the chain restarts the sentence on Edge; turn 3 the in-house TTS refuses outright. Every turn still gets spoken audio.
replies: Your order PN-10002, the smart scale, shipped three days ago by BlueDart express. The tracking number is B D 7 7 8 1 2 0 4 I N. BlueDart expects to deliver it in about two days. You'll get an SMS from the courier on the day of delivery.
Order PN-10004 is a blood pressure monitor delivered ten days ago. Since the box was opened, it can still be returned within the window, with a restocking fee. Would you like me to start the return?
Error E2 on the BP-200 means the cuff is too loose or was not inflated properly. Wrap it snugly, about two fingers' width above the elbow, and measure again.
